name: SHELTER Encinitas
notes: Photo 1 is a bottle-service/liquor list only and was skipped (drink-only). Photo 2 is a clean, fully legible printed menu branded 'L'ero' with a Shelter footer address (540 S Coast Hwy 101, Encinitas) and is the main source of dishes. Photo 3 shows two overlapping sheets on a table: a 'Shelter Specialty Cocktails' sheet (skipped, drink-only) and a 'NaPizza' food menu whose footer also shows the Shelter address, so it is included, but the printed per-slice prices on the Pizza al Taglio list were too small/angled to read reliably even after zooming, so those two items were kept without a price; the rest of the NaPizza menu (Insalate, Panini con Focaccia, Zuppa, Dolci) was too obscured by the overlapping cocktail sheet to transcribe. Confidence is medium because of this partially-illegible second menu.
